Script.name: recallmanager
Script.script:
--[[ Recall Manager — port of Solao_Recall_Manager (MUSHclient) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31 Clickable travel buttons you build yourself. Each button fires a '|'-separated list of commands. Ships empty; nothing about your character is baked in. The pipe separator is inherited from the MUSHclient version for a reason: with command stacking on, a typed ';' gets split before the plugin sees it. ]] aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.recall = aardkit.recall or {} local RM = aardkit.recall local U = aardkit.util local ROW_H = 22 local FOOT_H = 34 local COL = { btn = "#1b2540", hover = "#274060", border = "#3a4a6b", text = "#e6e6e6", dim = "#8a93a8", ok = "#3ad07a", } -- verbs the dispatcher owns; can't be used as button names local RESERVED = { add = true, edit = true, del = true, delete = true, at = true, rename = true, list = true, reset = true, help = true, ["?"] = true, show = true, hide = true, diag = true, var = true, vars = true, factoryreset = true, dock = true, embed = true, } local CFG = U.load("recall", { methods = {}, vars = {}, location = "?", last = "-" }) CFG.methods = CFG.methods or {} CFG.vars = CFG.vars or {} CFG.location = CFG.location or "?" CFG.last = CFG.last or "-" RM.trigs = RM.trigs or {} -- button name -> temp trigger id local pool = {} -- reusable Geyser labels local foot -- footer label --- -- helpers --- local function find(name) if not name then return end local key = name:lower() for i, m in ipairs(CFG.methods) do if m.name:lower() == key then return m, i end end end -- pull a name off the front; quote it to allow spaces. Returns name, remainder. local function parse_name(s) s = (s or ""):gsub("^%s+", "") local q = s:sub(1, 1) if q == "'" or q == '"' then return s:match("^" .. q .. "([^" .. q .. "]*)" .. q .. "%s*(.*)$") end return s:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") end local function valid_name(n) return n ~= nil and n ~= "" and n:match("^[%w][%w _%-]*$") ~= nil and not RESERVED[n:lower()] end local function save() U.save("recall", CFG) end --- -- arrival triggers --- local function drop_trigger(name) local id = RM.trigs[name] if id then killTrigger(id) end RM.trigs[name] = nil end local function make_trigger(m) drop_trigger(m.name) if not m.at or m.at == "" then return end local who = m.name local ok, id = pcall(tempRegexTrigger, m.at, function() RM.arrived(who) end) if ok then RM.trigs[who] = id else U.warn("Recall Manager: bad 'at' pattern for " .. who .. " - " .. tostring(id)) end end function RM.arrived(name) CFG.location = name RM.paint() end --- -- firing --- -- $name in a command is replaced from CFG.vars. Define an id/keyword once, -- reference it everywhere, change it in one place. local function subst(cmd) return (cmd:gsub("%$([%w_]+)", function(k) local v = CFG.vars[k] if v == nil then U.warn("Recall Manager: undefined var '$" .. k .. "'. Set it: recallmanager var " .. k .. " ") return "$" .. k end return v end)) end local function fire(m) for c in (m.cmds or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do send((subst(c):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))) end m.count = (m.count or 0) + 1 CFG.last = m.name CFG.location = m.name -- optimistic; an 'at' trigger refines it on arrival save() RM.paint() end --- -- ui --- local panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "recall", title = "Recall Manager", width = 220, height = 300, x = "20px", y = "120px", consoleless = true, -- panel.new() runs onbuild during construction, which is before RM.paint -- exists further down this file. The boot line at the bottom does the first -- real paint; this only matters on later rebuilds (a dock/embed flip). onbuild = function() pool, foot = {}, nil if RM.scrollreset then RM.scrollreset() end if RM.paint then RM.paint() end end, }) RM.panel = panel --- -- responsive grid -- -- Buttons flow into as many columns as the panel is wide enough for and as many -- rows as it is tall enough for, recomputed whenever the container changes size. -- Anything that doesn't fit scrolls: labels take wheel events via -- setLabelWheelCallback, which is a real Mudlet C++ call. --- local MIN_W = 120 -- narrower than this and we drop a column local GAP = 4 local offset = 0 -- first button index shown, for scrolling local function num(v) -- the extra parens matter: gsub returns (string, count) and without them the -- count lands in tonumber's *base* argument return tonumber((tostring(v or "0"):gsub("px", ""))) or 0 end local function metrics() local c = panel.container if not c then return 1, 1, 200, 200 end local w = num(c.get_width and c:get_width() or c.width) local h = num(c.get_height and c:get_height() or c.height) if w < 40 then w = 200 end if h < 40 then h = 200 end local cols = math.max(1, math.floor((w - GAP) / (MIN_W + GAP))) local rows = math.max(1, math.floor((h - FOOT_H - GAP) / ROW_H)) return cols, rows, w, h end function RM.scroll(by) local cols, rows = metrics() local page = cols * rows local maxoff = math.max(0, #CFG.methods - page) local new = math.max(0, math.min(maxoff, offset + by * cols)) if new ~= offset then offset = new RM.paint() end end -- one wheel notch = one row function RM.on_wheel(_, direction) RM.scroll((tonumber(direction) or 0) > 0 and -1 or 1) end local function label(i) if pool[i] then return pool[i] end local name = "aardkit_rm_btn" .. panel.gen .. "_" .. i local l = Geyser.Label:new({ name = name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = ROW_H - 3, }, panel.container) l:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 2px;", COL.btn, COL.border)) l:setClickCallback(function() local m = CFG.methods[i + offset] if m then fire(m) end end) l:setOnEnter(function() l:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 2px;", COL.hover, COL.border)) end) l:setOnLeave(function() l:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 2px;", COL.btn, COL.border)) end) -- Geyser has no wheel wrapper; go at the underlying label directly pcall(setLabelWheelCallback, name, "aardkit.recall.on_wheel") pool[i] = l return l end function RM.paint() if not panel.container then return end local cols, rows, w = metrics() local page = cols * rows local total = #CFG.methods if offset > math.max(0, total - page) then offset = math.max(0, total - page) end local colw = math.floor((w - GAP) / cols) - GAP local slot = 0 for i = 1, page do local m = CFG.methods[i + offset] if not m then break end slot = slot + 1 local l = label(slot) local r = math.floor((slot - 1) / cols) local c = (slot - 1) % cols l:move(GAP + c * (colw + GAP), GAP + r * ROW_H) l:resize(colw, ROW_H - 3) l:echo(string.format( " %s" .. " (%d)", COL.text, m.name, COL.dim, m.count or 0), nil, "l") l:show() end for i = slot + 1, #pool do pool[i]:hide() end if not foot then local fname = "aardkit_rm_foot" .. panel.gen foot = Geyser.Label:new({ name = fname, x = GAP, y = "-" .. FOOT_H .. "px", width = "96%", height = FOOT_H - 2, }, panel.container) foot:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0); border: 0px;") pcall(setLabelWheelCallback, fname, "aardkit.recall.on_wheel") end local body if total == 0 then body = string.format("No buttons yet.
recallmanager add <name> <cmds>", COL.dim) else local range = "" if total > page then range = string.format("  %d-%d of %d", COL.dim, offset + 1, math.min(offset + page, total), total) end body = string.format( "At: %s%s
" .. "Last: %s", COL.dim, COL.ok, CFG.location, range, COL.dim, CFG.last) end foot:echo(body, nil, "l") end -- The container is resized by dragging, which Geyser gives us no event for, so -- watch its dimensions and reflow when they change. Cheap: two reads a second. local lastw, lasth = 0, 0 function RM.checksize() local c = panel.container if not c then return end local w = num(c.get_width and c:get_width() or c.width) local h = num(c.get_height and c:get_height() or c.height) if w ~= lastw or h ~= lasth then lastw, lasth = w, h RM.paint() end end --- -- commands --- local function list() if #CFG.methods == 0 then U.note("No buttons yet. recallmanager add ") return end for _, m in ipairs(CFG.methods) do U.out("\n<#7aa2f7>" .. m.name .. " <#8a93a8>(" .. (m.count or 0) .. ")") U.out("\n <#8a93a8>cmds: <#c8d0dc>" .. (m.cmds or "") .. "") if m.at and m.at ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>at: <#c8d0dc>" .. m.at .. "") end end echo("\n") end local function help() U.help("Recall Manager", { { "recallmanager add ", "add a button (| separates commands)" }, { "recallmanager edit ", "change its commands" }, { "recallmanager del ", "remove it" }, { "recallmanager at ", "arrival line -> sets 'At:'" }, { "recallmanager var ", "define $name for use in commands" }, { "recallmanager ", "fire it (same as clicking)" }, { "recallmanager list | vars | reset", "" }, { "recallmanager dock | embed | show | hide", "" }, { "recallmanager diag", "what the panel thinks it built" }, { "recallmanager factoryreset confirm", "wipe ALL buttons + vars" }, { "" }, { "use $name in a command to insert a var (e.g. get $bus $bag)" }, { "quote multi-word names: recallmanager add 'Clan Hall' recall" }, }) end function RM.cmd(arg) arg = U.trim(arg) if arg == "" then panel:toggle(); return end local lverb = arg:match("^(%S+)"):lower() -- anything that isn't a management verb is a button name to fire if not RESERVED[lverb] then local fname = arg:gsub("^(['\"])(.*)%1$", "%2") local m = find(fname) if m then fire(m) else U.warn("Recall Manager: no button '" .. fname .. "'. Try 'recallmanager list'.") end return end local rest = arg:match("^%S+%s*(.*)$") or "" if lverb == "help" or lverb == "?" then help() elseif lverb == "list" then list() elseif lverb == "show" then panel:show() elseif lverb == "hide" then panel:hide() elseif lverb == "dock" then panel:setmode("dock") elseif lverb == "embed" then panel:setmode("embed") elseif lverb == "diag" then local c = panel.container U.help("Recall Manager diagnostics", { { "panel mode", tostring(panel.mode) }, { "container", c and tostring(c.name) or "NIL" }, { "visible", tostring(panel:visible()) }, { "buttons", tostring(#CFG.methods) }, { "labels built", tostring(#pool) }, { "grid", (function() local c, r, w, h = metrics() return string.format("%d cols x %d rows (panel %dx%d)", c, r, w, h) end)() }, { "label 1", pool[1] and string.format("x=%s y=%s w=%s h=%s", tostring(pool[1].x), tostring(pool[1].y), tostring(pool[1].width), tostring(pool[1].height)) or "none" }, { "footer", foot and "yes" or "none" }, { "" }, { "computed pos", c and string.format("x=%s y=%s %sx%s", tostring(c.get_x and c:get_x()), tostring(c.get_y and c:get_y()), tostring(c.get_width and c:get_width()), tostring(c.get_height and c:get_height())) or "n/a" }, { "main window", (function() local w, h = getMainWindowSize() return tostring(w) .. "x" .. tostring(h) end)() }, }) if c then U.note("Forcing visible and repainting...") c:show() RM.paint() end elseif lverb == "reset" then for _, m in ipairs(CFG.methods) do m.count = 0 end CFG.last = "-" save(); RM.paint() U.ok("Recall Manager: counters reset.") elseif lverb == "factoryreset" then if rest:match("^%s*confirm%s*$") then for _, m in ipairs(CFG.methods) do drop_trigger(m.name) end CFG.methods, CFG.vars = {}, {} CFG.location, CFG.last = "?", "-" save(); RM.paint() U.ok("Recall Manager: factory reset - all buttons and vars cleared.") else U.warn("This wipes ALL buttons and vars and cannot be undone.") U.warn("Confirm with: recallmanager factoryreset confirm") end elseif lverb == "add" then local n, cmds = parse_name(rest) if not valid_name(n) then U.warn("Bad name. Letters/digits/space/_/- and not a reserved word. Quote multi-word names.") elseif not cmds or cmds == "" then U.warn("Usage: recallmanager add ") elseif find(n) then U.warn("'" .. n .. "' exists. Use: recallmanager edit " .. n .. " ...") else table.insert(CFG.methods, { name = n, cmds = cmds, count = 0 }) save(); RM.paint() U.ok("Recall Manager: added " .. n .. " = " .. cmds) end elseif lverb == "edit" then local n, cmds = parse_name(rest) local m = find(n) if not m or not cmds or cmds == "" then U.warn("Usage: recallmanager edit ") else m.cmds = cmds save() U.ok("Recall Manager: " .. m.name .. " = " .. cmds) end elseif lverb == "del" or lverb == "delete" then local n = parse_name(rest) local m, i = find(n) if not m then U.warn("Usage: recallmanager del ") else drop_trigger(m.name) table.remove(CFG.methods, i) save(); RM.paint() U.ok("Recall Manager: removed " .. m.name) end elseif lverb == "at" then local n, pat = parse_name(rest) local m = find(n) if not m or not pat or pat == "" then U.warn("Usage: recallmanager at ") elseif pat == "off" then m.at = nil; drop_trigger(m.name); save() U.ok("Recall Manager: " .. m.name .. " arrival cleared") else m.at = pat; make_trigger(m); save() U.ok("Recall Manager: " .. m.name .. " arrival = " .. pat) end elseif lverb == "var" then local n, v = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if not n or not n:match("^[%w_]+$") then U.warn("Usage: recallmanager var (one word; reference as $name)") elseif v == "off" then CFG.vars[n] = nil; save() U.ok("Recall Manager: cleared $" .. n) else CFG.vars[n] = v; save() U.ok("Recall Manager: $" .. n .. " = " .. v) end elseif lverb == "vars" then if not next(CFG.vars) then U.note("No vars. recallmanager var ") else local keys = {} for k in pairs(CFG.vars) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort(keys) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do U.out("\n <#e0af68>$" .. k .. " = <#c8d0dc>" .. CFG.vars[k] .. "") end echo("\n") end else -- A word in RESERVED with no branch above lands here. Without this the -- chain just ended and the command did nothing at all, silently — which -- is exactly how 'diag' looked broken when it was only half-added. U.warn("Recall Manager: '" .. lverb .. "' is reserved but not implemented.") help() end end --- -- boot --- function RM.scrollreset() offset = 0 end for _, m in ipairs(CFG.methods) do make_trigger(m) end RM.paint() -- reflow when the panel is dragged to a new size, and when the window changes U.every("recallsize", 0.5, RM.checksize) U.killhandler(aardkit_recall_resize_handler) aardkit_recall_resize_handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysWindowResizeEvent", "aardkit.recall.paint") aardkit.register("recall", "clickable travel/recall buttons", RM.cmd)
